flow.purpose: Authoritative provenance for every legal-sensitive record.
Common India-wide educational knowledge, signs, markings, licence flow and quiz content.
State/UT overrides, local rules, dynamic values and official service links.
Merge baseline + selected jurisdiction without silently replacing common content.
Render Home, Learn, Rules, Exam and Tools from the resolved dataset.
Store local practice attempts and weak-area signals only; no legal source data is mutated.

principles: UI never hardcodes legal facts that belong in JSON.
National baseline and jurisdiction data remain separate.
Jurisdiction values are shown only with their verification state.
Dynamic values such as fees, penalties and speed limits require jurisdiction-specific source verification.
Traffic signs are data records plus dedicated assets; the same asset is never reused for unrelated signs.
A quiz question references its sign/rule/marking by ID where applicable.
Official links are navigation aids, not evidence that an action has been completed.
